hypothesis: Does training against a diverse opponent pool improve a compact CABT policy's win rate on held-out deck families?

study_configuration.pairing: matched deck pair and seed with reversed player assignments
study_configuration.eval_seed_role: Evaluation seeds label games only. Agents are built explicitly, so the seeds do not reach any agent, and the CABT engine shuffles with std::random_device. Games cannot be replayed from a seed; the stored replays are the record.
